What we do

The whole trip, booked by a person

Tell us where you're going — or let us help you pick. We compare flights, hotels and packages across suppliers and book the combination that fits your dates and your budget.

Flights & Airfare

Domestic and international flights on the major airlines — including multi-city trips, family groups and last-minute changes, with a person to call if plans shift.

Ask about flights →

Vacation Packages

Flight + hotel bundles and all-inclusive resorts in the Caribbean, Mexico and beyond — honeymoons, family vacations and winter escapes, transfers included.

Ask about packages →

Cruises

Ocean and river cruises from New York and beyond — cabin selection, dining and shore excursions sorted before you sail, for couples, families and groups.

Ask about cruises →

Tours & Group Travel

Guided tours and custom itineraries — plus group trips for reunions, weddings, churches and schools, with everyone's flights and rooms coordinated together.

Ask about tours →

Why Rainbow Travel

A website can't rebook you at midnight

Booking sites are fine until something changes. A neighborhood agency earns its keep on everything around the ticket.

A person who knows your trip

The agent who booked you is the agent you call — in the store, on Fort Hamilton Pkwy, not an overseas call queue. We keep your dates, your travelers and your preferences on file.

The details, checked twice

Passport validity, name spellings that match your ID exactly, connection times that actually work, seats together for the kids — caught before you pay, not at the gate.

Help when plans change

Weather, delays, a family emergency — we rebook, reroute and call the airline on your behalf, and tell you honestly what each option costs before you choose.

Groups without the chaos

Reunions, destination weddings, church and school trips: one coordinator, one payment conversation, everyone on the same flights and in the same hotel.

One visit covers the paperwork, too

Rainbow Travel offers travel insurance and notary services in-house — so the trip, the coverage, and the signed consent forms and documents your trip needs can all be handled at the same counter, in the same stop.
